profile.label: Habits
profile.value: Bounces a ball off the wall while thinking · Keeps a fixed pre-game routine

p0-dark.monologue: …Did I fall asleep again? It's dark.

p1-mid.monologue: The room seems to have gotten darker.

p1-late.monologue: Going through things one by one, that day keeps coming back to me.

turn-silence.monologue: I don't want to remember. I don't want to face it.

turn-bottom.monologue: …That can't be right. The radio's picking up a different signal.

turn-signal.monologue: The Eungang High gym, they said.

p2-enter.monologue: I have to get there within four nights.

p4-enter.monologue: Mom and Dad's bedroom. First time I've been in here since that day.

resolve.monologue: Bag, ampoule. The bat's by the front door.

report-card-intro.line1: This is my September mock exam report.
report-card-intro.line2: It was the last mock exam before the real one, and my scores weren't great.
report-card-intro.line3: The evening I showed it to them.
report-card-intro.line4: Maybe we should look into a math tutor?
report-card-intro.line5: Studying isn't the only answer in life, you know.
report-card-intro.line7: Once the baseball tournament was over, all that was left was the entrance exam.
report-card-intro.line8: If things were normal, the exam would be… a month away.

ball-intro.line1: Three years on the baseball team. It was my last summer.
ball-intro.line2: Nationals round of 16, against Eungang High. Bottom of the ninth, two outs, and I was the last batter.
ball-intro.line3: Yunho yelled from the on-deck circle. "Hit it, Han Do-hae!"
ball-intro.line4: Their catcher smacked his mitt twice, thwack thwack, and crouched down.
ball-intro.line5: He looked so sure of himself, like he'd catch anything no matter how I swung.
ball-intro.line6: Full count. The ball came off my bat and popped up high behind the plate.
ball-intro.line7: He tossed his mask, ran it down, and caught it. That was it.
ball-intro.line8: That was my last baseball game.

ball-alone.line1: Even when I throw again, I don't feel that rush in my blood like I used to.

console-intro.line1: Haven't played in a while. One round?
console-intro.line2: Juwan and I used to play for bets all the time. He lost more often than not, though.

console-alone.line2: …What's the point of winning by myself?

console-echo.line1: When all this is over, let's play again.

frame-photo.line1: This is from the youth baseball tournament, the day we placed.
frame-photo.line2: Yunho was probably next to me. We've played baseball together since then.

phone-stopped.line1: The last message is from October 19.

window-silence.line1: The first few days, the sirens went all night.
window-silence.line2: Now… there's no sound at all.

calendar-intro.line1: The calendar stopped there too. October 19.

calendar-tally.line1: How many tally marks is that now…
calendar-tally.line2: I stopped counting. Counting makes it feel longer.

radio-intro.line2: …Not that it'll pick up anything but noise.

duffel-pack.line1: Let's empty out my baseball bag.
duffel-pack.line2: Water, cans, a flashlight. That should do it.

duffel-take.line1: Water, canned food, a flashlight. It's all in.

fridge-open.line1: If I'm going out, I should take something. Start with the fridge.
fridge-open.line2: I've been eating for a month and it's still half full.
fridge-open.line3: Two nights, they said. So why stock this much?

shoes-open.line1: It's been ages since I opened the shoe cabinet.
shoes-open.line2: Dad's hiking boots are still here.
shoes-open.line3: We're keeping this trip light. Just a little sightseeing close by!
shoes-open.line4: They said light, but they definitely took two suitcases.
shoes-open.line5: …The spot where the suitcases go is empty.

cards-intro.line1: There's a note on the table.

cards-memo.line2: The bottom drawer. Does she mean the one in the fridge?
cards-memo.line3: And the two strokes after RX… what was she counting?

computer-power-on.line1: Not like the internet works even if I turn it on.
computer-power-on.line2: …I'll at least look at what's saved.
computer-power-on.line3: I press the power button on the dust-covered tower.

computer-archive.line1: Dad's email. He sounds so excited about the trip.
computer-archive.line2: The news says… it started near a research facility.
computer-archive.line3: The first report was at 3 p.m.

phone-mom-intro.line1: My chat with Mom. The last message is from that morning.

phone-mom-read.line1: …7:12? The news didn't come out until the afternoon.

ball-echo.line2: Once I'm out of here, I'm throwing again.

ampoule-note.line1: There's a note stuck on the fridge's bottom drawer.
ampoule-note.line2: It's the drawer from Mom's note.

ampoule-found.line1: One ampoule. …The slot next to it is empty.
ampoule-found.line2: Half a logo is left on the label.
ampoule-found.line3: This logo… I've seen it somewhere.

ampoule-taken.line1: Mom and Dad left this behind. I'm taking it with me.

computer-logo-intro.line1: Raon Life Science Institute. I think that logo was in one of Dad's emails.

computer-logo-found.line1: Raon Life Science Institute. Same as the one on Dad's badge.
computer-logo-found.line2: Tidy up the shelves a bit, will you?

research-note-intro.line1: Papers are scattered across the desk.
research-note-intro.line2: Mom's handwriting. Each piece has a date on it.

research-note-read.line1: They were both researchers. At Raon Life Science Institute.
research-note-read.line2: It wasn't a trip. They were called in to the institute.
research-note-read.line3: RX-11. A candidate cure. …They made two, and one slot was empty.

id-card-look.line1: These look like Mom and Dad's work badges..?

id-card-found.line1: Raon Life Science Institute. Dad's name, Mom's name.
id-card-found.line2: Held up to the light, a logo shows over the photo. It's the one from the ampoule label.

report-card.title: September Mock Exam
report-card.phase1: Bad scores. Mom said tutor. Dad said it was fine.

console.title: Not fun anymore
console.phase1: Alone, winning and losing feel the same.
console.phase2: Maybe it gets fun again with two.

ball.title: Catch, Alone
ball.phase1: Throw it at the wall and it comes back. Yunho isn't here to catch it.
ball.phase2: If someone can catch it, this ball still has a use.

frame.title: My Parents
frame.phase1: Wiped clean, and still I can't see their two faces.
frame.phase2: I pictured my parents' faces and stood the frame back up.

phone.title: The Silence
phone.phase1: The group chat has been quiet since that day.
phone.phase2: 7:12 a.m. Mom's last text: come straight home.

calendar.title: October 19
calendar.phase1: To count the days that went by, I just kept making tally marks.

window.title: Outside
window.phase1: Broken glass, a crushed car. I closed the window again.

radio.title: That Broadcast
radio.phase1: I'm afraid to face what's really out there.
radio.phase2: Survivors at the Eungang High gym. I've heard that voice somewhere.

duffel.title: What to Take
duffel.phase2: I repacked the bag. Almost left the glove, then put it back in.
duffel.phase3: I shouldered the packed bag. The glove is in it.

fridge.title: What They Stocked
fridge.phase2: Why did our home have a month's worth of food?

shoes.title: The Boots They Left
shoes.phase2: The hiking boots are still here, but they took two suitcases.

cards.title: The Note on the Table
cards.phase2: "Bottom drawer. RX ||" Mom's note on the table.

computer.title: What Was Saved
computer.phase2: It started near a research facility. First report: 3 p.m.
computer.phase3: Dad's email: the Raon logo, and one line. "Tidy up the shelves."

ampoule.title: An Unmarked Ampoule
ampoule.phase2: One ampoule in the case, the next slot empty. A faded logo on the label.
ampoule.phase3: I took the ampoule. The one that might be a cure.

research-note.title: Research Log
research-note.phase2: Both were Raon researchers. The ampoule: a candidate cure. The trip: a summons.

id-card.title: Access Badges
id-card.phase2: Raon access badges. The hologram bears the logo from the ampoule label.

cut1.line1: Past entrance-exam questions. Han Do-hae. That's my handwriting.
cut1.line2: I played my last season with the baseball team in the summer, and after that it was back to senior-year life.
cut1.line3: I bought this back then, too. Trying to play the part of a test-taker.

cut1.line1: I used to play games a lot with Juwan, a friend from my class.
cut1.line2: The week exams ended, he'd come over and we'd play fighting games in two-player mode.
cut1.line3: I think I won a little more often.
cut1.line4: We said we'd swap characters next time.
cut1.line5: …I can't remember the last time we played.

cut1.line1: I'd played baseball for years, so I went to Cheongseo High, a school known for baseball.
cut1.line2: In this year's nationals round of 16, we faced Eungang High, a nearby school and our baseball rival.
cut1.line3: I played second base, and I psyched myself up with my best friend Yunho, our catcher.
cut1.line4: But we lost in the end. I still remember the last pop of Eungang's catcher's mitt, the sound that ended the game.
cut1.line5: I wonder what Yunho's doing now.

cut1.line1: Listening to the radio, nothing but noise, the memory of that day comes back.

cut3.line1: …This is an emergency broadcast. An infectious disease of unknown origin has broken out. All citizens must take shelter indoors immediately.
cut3.line2: The infection has spread past the capital region into the entire south.
cut3.line3: The infection has now reached Busan. …Repeat. This is an emergency broadcast.

cut4.line2: After extra classes, I checked my phone and there was a text from Mom.
cut4.line3: "Skip the study room today and come straight home." …That was a strange thing to say.

cut5.line2: A car sitting there with its door open. No one around.
cut5.line4: All the way to my door, everything was the same as always.

cut6.line1: Someone was standing in the hallway.

cut9.line2: The sounds behind me weren't human.

cut10.line2: Mom and Dad were away on their trip, so there was no one home.
cut10.line3: Silence settled in, as if none of the panic had been real.

cut11.line2: Infection, spread, evacuation. The anchor was shouting unfamiliar words in a panic.
cut11.line3: Screams came from every direction. I covered my ears.

cut12.line1: Ever since that day, I've been shut in at home.
cut12.line2: Because I was afraid of what I'd have to face out there.

cut4.line1: Hey, anyone out there? …Is this even going out?

cut5.line1: We've got survivors gathered here at the Eungang High gym.

cut7.line1: I hooked a transmitter up to the broadcast room gear, so it won't reach far. You'll hear it around here, though.

cut8.line1: After four nights, we're moving out. We got word a helicopter's coming.

cut9.line1: So if anyone's listening, get to the Eungang High gym. …Don't be late.

cut11.line1: Eungang High…? That guy from back then…?

cut1.line1: Two nights, but two suitcases. They packed for a month.
It wasn't a trip. They both knew something.

cut1.line2: Mom and Dad left to protect this. It was never a trip.
cut1.line3: Take the ampoule and get to the Eungang High gym within four days.

cut1.line1: Three years with this bat. All I ever hit with it was a ball.
